title: Analytics Dashboard
description: A real-time analytics platform with interactive charts, data visualization, and customizable widgets. Built for teams to monitor KPIs and make data-driven decisions at a glance.

title: FilmSense – AI-Powered Movie Discovery Platform
description: FilmSense is a full stack movie discovery app that lets users search by Genre, Character, and Theme instead of just a title, using semantic search over a Qdrant vector database and Sentence Transformers embeddings. It includes a Movie Details page that pulls together overview, cast, ratings, and trailer data automatically, along with a live dashboard monitoring system resources. Built with FastAPI on the backend and React with TypeScript on the frontend, with fuzzy matching and guardrails to keep results accurate even with typos or vague input.
